_comment: Hand-curated source for named regions (spec 2.4). Members are place keys: ISO country (CH), subdivision CC-CODE using GeographicData short codes (FR-13), US county FIPS (06001) or city id (gn:123). Metros list a Census CBSA code instead of members; scripts/build_named_regions.py expands them. Regenerate ios/Footprint/Resources/GeoData/named_regions.json with that script after editing.
cbsaDelineation: July 2023 (Census list1_2023.xlsx); top 25 metropolitan statistical areas by Vintage 2024 population estimate
